title: Claude Code — Intelligence
description: Comprehensive developer intelligence: session health, cost analysis, token breakdown, and tool usage patterns.

list.name: plan_monthly_cost
list.label: Plan ($/mo)
list.description: Your Claude subscription tier. Controls plan cost used in ROI panel. Set CLAUDE_PLAN_TYPE env var in hooks to match.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({app="claude-dev-logging", component="lifecycle"} | json | hook_type="session-end" | project=~"$project" [$__range]))
sum(sum_over_time({app="claude-token-metrics"} | json | model=~"$model" | project=~"$project" | effort=~"$effort" | unwrap cost_usd [$__range]))

panels.title: Plan ROI
panels.description: API-equivalent retail cost ÷ your plan cost. 1× = break-even. 5× = got 5× your money’s worth. Change the Plan dropdown to match your tier.

targets.expr: sum(sum_over_time({app="claude-token-metrics"} | json | model=~"$model" | project=~"$project" | effort=~"$effort" | unwrap cost_usd [$__range]))

panels.title: Cache Efficiency
panels.description: % of context tokens served from cache. High is good — less quota burn.

targets.expr: sum(sum_over_time({app="claude-token-metrics"} | json | model=~"$model" | project=~"$project" | effort=~"$effort" | unwrap total_cache_read_tokens [$__range]))
sum(sum_over_time({app="claude-token-metrics"} | json | model=~"$model" | project=~"$project" | effort=~"$effort" | unwrap total_cache_creation_tokens [$__range]))
sum(sum_over_time({app="claude-token-metrics"} | json | model=~"$model" | project=~"$project" | effort=~"$effort" | unwrap total_input_tokens [$__range]))
sum(count_over_time({app="claude-dev-logging", component=~"tool|mcp-.*"} | json | hook_type="post-tool-use" | project=~"$project" [$__range]))
sum(count_over_time({app="claude-dev-logging", level="ERROR"} | json | project=~"$project" [$__range]))
sum(sum_over_time({app="claude-token-metrics"} | json | model=~"$model" | project=~"$project" | effort=~"$effort" | unwrap cost_usd [$__range]))
sum(count_over_time({app="claude-token-metrics"} | json | model=~"$model" | project=~"$project" | effort=~"$effort" [$__range]))
sum(sum_over_time({app="claude-token-metrics"} | json | model=~"$model" | project=~"$project" | effort=~"$effort" | unwrap assistant_turns [$__range]))
sum(count_over_time({app="claude-token-metrics"} | json | model=~"$model" | project=~"$project" | effort=~"$effort" [$__range]))

panels.title: API Cost Over Time
panels.description: Cost per interval by model. $100 dashed line = monthly Max 5x plan cost.

targets.expr: sum by (model) (sum_over_time({app="claude-token-metrics"} | json | model=~"$model" | project=~"$project" | effort=~"$effort" | unwrap cost_usd [$__interval]))

panels.title: Token Usage by Type
panels.description: Cache reads dominate — that's your context window in action. Output includes thinking tokens.

targets.expr: sum(sum_over_time({app="claude-token-metrics"} | json | model=~"$model" | project=~"$project" | effort=~"$effort" | unwrap total_cache_read_tokens [$__interval]))
sum(sum_over_time({app="claude-token-metrics"} | json | model=~"$model" | project=~"$project" | effort=~"$effort" | unwrap total_cache_creation_tokens [$__interval]))
sum(sum_over_time({app="claude-token-metrics"} | json | model=~"$model" | project=~"$project" | effort=~"$effort" | unwrap total_output_tokens [$__interval]))
sum(sum_over_time({app="claude-token-metrics"} | json | model=~"$model" | project=~"$project" | effort=~"$effort" | unwrap total_input_tokens [$__interval]))

panels.title: Tool Calls by Tool
panels.description: Tool usage frequency over time. Stacked bars show relative contribution of each tool per interval.

targets.expr: sum by (tool_name) (count_over_time({app="claude-dev-logging", component=~"tool|mcp-.*"} | json | hook_type="post-tool-use" | project=~"$project" [$__interval]))
sum by (tool_name) (count_over_time({app="claude-dev-logging", component=~"tool|mcp-.*"} | json | hook_type="post-tool-use" | project=~"$project" [$__range]))
sum by (model) (sum_over_time({app="claude-token-metrics"} | json | model=~"$model" | project=~"$project" | effort=~"$effort" | unwrap cost_usd [$__interval]))
sum by (effort) (count_over_time({app="claude-token-metrics"} | json | model=~"$model" | project=~"$project" | effort=~"$effort" [$__interval]))
sum by (project) (sum_over_time({app="claude-token-metrics"} | json | model=~"$model" | project=~"$project" | effort=~"$effort" | unwrap cost_usd [$__interval]))

panels.title: Cost by Effort Level
panels.description: Total API-equivalent cost aggregated by effort setting. Lower effort = faster/cheaper; higher effort = more thinking, more cost.

targets.expr: sum by (effort) (sum_over_time({app="claude-token-metrics"} | json | model=~"$model" | project=~"$project" | effort=~"$effort" | unwrap cost_usd [$__range]))

panels.title: Sessions by Type
panels.description: How sessions are started: startup (new), resume (continuation), compact (post-compaction restart).

targets.expr: sum by (session_type) (count_over_time({app="claude-dev-logging", component="lifecycle"} | json | hook_type="session-start" | project=~"$project" [$__range]))

panels.title: Session Breakdown
panels.description: All sessions in selected time range, sorted by API cost. tool_use_count and thinking columns show session characteristics.

targets.expr: {app="claude-token-metrics"} | json | model=~"$model" | project=~"$project" | effort=~"$effort"

panels.title: Burn Rate — $/hr & Tokens/min
panels.description: How fast you are consuming API-equivalent budget. Averages over the selected time window.

panels.title: Avg $/hour
panels.description: API-equivalent spending rate per hour averaged over selected range.

targets.expr: sum(rate({app="claude-token-metrics"} | json | model=~"$model" | project=~"$project" | effort=~"$effort" | unwrap cost_usd [$__range])) * 3600

panels.title: Avg $/minute
panels.description: API-equivalent spending rate per minute averaged over selected range.

targets.expr: sum(rate({app="claude-token-metrics"} | json | model=~"$model" | project=~"$project" | effort=~"$effort" | unwrap cost_usd [$__range])) * 60

panels.title: Output Tokens/min
panels.description: Average Claude output token generation rate per minute.

targets.expr: sum(rate({app="claude-token-metrics"} | json | model=~"$model" | project=~"$project" | effort=~"$effort" | unwrap total_output_tokens [$__range])) * 60

panels.title: Total Tokens/min
panels.description: Input + output token consumption rate per minute.

targets.expr: sum(rate({app="claude-token-metrics"} | json | model=~"$model" | project=~"$project" | effort=~"$effort" | unwrap total_input_tokens [$__range])) * 60
sum(rate({app="claude-token-metrics"} | json | model=~"$model" | project=~"$project" | effort=~"$effort" | unwrap total_output_tokens [$__range])) * 60

panels.title: Tool Performance — Duration & Cost Correlation
panels.description: How long each tool type takes. Correlates tool execution time with token cost per turn.

panels.title: Avg Duration by Tool (ms)
panels.description: Average wall-clock milliseconds per tool call, broken down by tool name. Slowest tools = biggest opportunity for parallelization.

targets.expr: avg by (tool_name) (avg_over_time({app="claude-dev-logging", component="tool"} | json | __error__="" | hook_type="post-tool-use" | tool_name!="" | model=~"$model" | project=~"$project" | effort=~"$effort" | unwrap duration_ms [$__range]))

panels.title: Call Count by Tool
panels.description: Total number of calls per tool in the selected time range. High counts = frequently used tools.

targets.expr: sum by (tool_name) (count_over_time({app="claude-dev-logging", component="tool"} | json | __error__="" | hook_type="post-tool-use" | tool_name!="" | model=~"$model" | project=~"$project" | effort=~"$effort" [$__range]))

panels.title: Tool Wall-Clock Time vs Token Cost per Turn
panels.description: Purple bars = total tool execution time per turn (ms). Teal line = API cost per turn (USD). Turns with high tool time but low cost = I/O bound. High cost but low tool time = LLM compute bound.

targets.expr: sum(sum_over_time({app="claude-token-metrics"} | json | __error__="" | model=~"$model" | project=~"$project" | effort=~"$effort" | unwrap tool_time_ms [$__interval]))
sum(sum_over_time({app="claude-token-metrics"} | json | __error__="" | model=~"$model" | project=~"$project" | effort=~"$effort" | unwrap cost_usd [$__interval]))

panels.title: Total Tool Overhead (This Range)
panels.description: Sum of all tool wall-clock time. Divide by total API cost to see what % of session time was in tool execution vs LLM compute.

targets.expr: sum(sum_over_time({app="claude-dev-logging", component="tool"} | json | __error__="" | hook_type="post-tool-use" | tool_name!="" | model=~"$model" | project=~"$project" | effort=~"$effort" | unwrap duration_ms [$__range]))

panels.title: Avg Tool Duration per Call
panels.description: Mean duration across all tool calls. Spikes indicate slow external services (MCP, file I/O, etc.).

targets.expr: avg(avg_over_time({app="claude-dev-logging", component="tool"} | json | __error__="" | hook_type="post-tool-use" | tool_name!="" | model=~"$model" | project=~"$project" | effort=~"$effort" | unwrap duration_ms [$__range]))

panels.title: Total Tool Calls
panels.description: Total number of tool invocations in the selected time range.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({app="claude-dev-logging", component="tool"} | json | __error__="" | hook_type="post-tool-use" | tool_name!="" | model=~"$model" | project=~"$project" | effort=~"$effort" [$__range]))
